decisions.reason: The net price display plugin builds directly on the firm's shop customization and analytics expertise, so the firm can interpret feedback and improve it through its own R&D.
The price comparison tracking plugin leverages the firm's existing e-commerce optimization knowledge, enabling learning from market results and continuous improvement.
This plugin draws on the firm's established analytics and marketing capabilities, allowing the firm to assimilate early results and enhance the product.
